package domain

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"time"
	"unicode/utf8"
)

var (
	ErrInvalidTeacherDialogJob      = errors.New("invalid teacher dialog job")
	ErrTeacherDialogRequestConflict = errors.New("teacher dialog request conflict")
	ErrTeacherDialogLeaseLost       = errors.New("teacher dialog job lease lost")
	ErrTeacherDialogCursorBlocked   = errors.New("teacher dialog cursor blocked")
)

type TeacherDialogJobStatus string

const (
	TeacherDialogJobQueued          TeacherDialogJobStatus = "queued"
	TeacherDialogJobProcessing      TeacherDialogJobStatus = "processing"
	TeacherDialogJobDeliveryPending TeacherDialogJobStatus = "delivery_pending"
	TeacherDialogJobDelivered       TeacherDialogJobStatus = "delivered"
	TeacherDialogJobCompleted       TeacherDialogJobStatus = "completed"
	TeacherDialogJobBlocked         TeacherDialogJobStatus = "blocked"
)

const (
	TeacherDialogErrorUnsupportedContext = "unsupported_context"
	TeacherDialogErrorTeacherIdentity    = "teacher_identity"
	TeacherDialogErrorDialogContext      = "dialog_context"
	TeacherDialogErrorContextBudget      = "context_budget"
	TeacherDialogErrorStudentContext     = "student_context"
	TeacherDialogErrorGeneration         = "generation"
	TeacherDialogErrorDelivery           = "delivery"
	TeacherDialogErrorPersistence        = "persistence"
	maximumTeacherResponseRunes          = 12000
	maximumTeacherResponseBytes          = 48000
)

// TeacherDialogJob is private orchestration state, not a conversation store.
// Only a generated response awaiting idempotent Dialog append is retained.
type TeacherDialogJob struct {
	Request                   DialogTeacherRequest
	TeacherJobID              string
	Status                    TeacherDialogJobStatus
	ClaimToken                string
	WorkerID                  string
	DecisionID                string
	ResponseBody              string
	DeliveredMessageID        string
	AIExecutionID             string
	CoordinatorMode           string
	ResponseAssistantUI       json.RawMessage
	ResponseAssistantUIDigest string
	StudentCommandID          string
	TerminalOutcome           TeacherTurnTerminalOutcome
	ReconciliationState       TeacherTurnReconciliationState
	NoEffectProofID           string
	RecoverableOutcomeID      string
	ErrorCode                 string
	Attempts                  int
	NextAttemptAt             time.Time
	LockedUntil               time.Time
	AcceptedAt                time.Time
	UpdatedAt                 time.Time
	DeliveredAt               time.Time
}

func NewTeacherDialogJob(request DialogTeacherRequest, now time.Time) (TeacherDialogJob, error) {
	normalizedRequest, err := NewDialogTeacherRequest(request)
	if err != nil || now.IsZero() {
		return TeacherDialogJob{}, ErrInvalidTeacherDialogJob
	}
	now = now.UTC()
	job := TeacherDialogJob{
		Request: normalizedRequest, StudentCommandID: normalizedRequest.StudentCommandID, Status: TeacherDialogJobQueued,
		NextAttemptAt: now, AcceptedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now,
	}
	if !SupportsTeacherDialogRuntime(normalizedRequest.ContextType) {
		job.Status = TeacherDialogJobBlocked
		job.ErrorCode = TeacherDialogErrorUnsupportedContext
	}
	return NormalizeTeacherDialogJob(job)
}

func SupportsTeacherDialogRuntime(contextType LearningContextType) bool {
	return contextType == LearningContextGeneral || contextType == LearningContextLesson || contextType == LearningContextLessonTask ||
		contextType == LearningContextPracticeTask ||
		contextType == LearningContextProject
}

func NormalizeTeacherDialogJob(input TeacherDialogJob) (TeacherDialogJob, error) {
	request, err := NewDialogTeacherRequest(input.Request)
	if err != nil {
		return TeacherDialogJob{}, ErrInvalidTeacherDialogJob
	}
	input.Request = request
	input.ClaimToken = strings.TrimSpace(input.ClaimToken)
	input.WorkerID = strings.TrimSpace(input.WorkerID)
	input.TeacherJobID = strings.TrimSpace(input.TeacherJobID)
	input.DecisionID = strings.TrimSpace(input.DecisionID)
	input.ResponseBody = strings.TrimSpace(input.ResponseBody)
	input.DeliveredMessageID = strings.TrimSpace(input.DeliveredMessageID)
	input.AIExecutionID = strings.TrimSpace(input.AIExecutionID)
	input.CoordinatorMode = strings.TrimSpace(input.CoordinatorMode)
	if input.CoordinatorMode == "" {
		input.CoordinatorMode = "legacy"
	}
	input.ResponseAssistantUIDigest = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.ResponseAssistantUIDigest))
	input.StudentCommandID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentCommandID)
	input.TerminalOutcome = TeacherTurnTerminalOutcome(strings.TrimSpace(string(input.TerminalOutcome)))
	input.ReconciliationState = TeacherTurnReconciliationState(strings.TrimSpace(string(input.ReconciliationState)))
	input.NoEffectProofID = strings.TrimSpace(input.NoEffectProofID)
	input.RecoverableOutcomeID = strings.TrimSpace(input.RecoverableOutcomeID)
	input.ErrorCode = strings.TrimSpace(input.ErrorCode)
	input.NextAttemptAt = input.NextAttemptAt.UTC()
	input.LockedUntil = input.LockedUntil.UTC()
	input.AcceptedAt = input.AcceptedAt.UTC()
	input.UpdatedAt = input.UpdatedAt.UTC()
	input.DeliveredAt = input.DeliveredAt.UTC()

	if input.Attempts < 0 || input.NextAttemptAt.IsZero() || input.AcceptedAt.IsZero() || input.UpdatedAt.IsZero() ||
		len(input.WorkerID) > 128 || len(input.ErrorCode) > 64 ||
		(input.ResponseBody != "" && (!utf8.ValidString(input.ResponseBody) || len(input.ResponseBody) > maximumTeacherResponseBytes || utf8.RuneCountInString(input.ResponseBody) > maximumTeacherResponseRunes)) {
		return TeacherDialogJob{}, ErrInvalidTeacherDialogJob
	}
	if input.CoordinatorMode != "legacy" && input.CoordinatorMode != "onboarding_action" && input.CoordinatorMode != "onboarding_text" {
		return TeacherDialogJob{}, ErrInvalidTeacherDialogJob
	}
	if len(input.ResponseAssistantUI) == 0 {
		if input.ResponseAssistantUIDigest != "" {
			return TeacherDialogJob{}, ErrInvalidTeacherDialogJob
		}
	} else {
		digest, digestErr := DigestTeacherAssistantUI(input.ResponseAssistantUI)
		if digestErr != nil || input.CoordinatorMode == "legacy" || digest != input.ResponseAssistantUIDigest {
			return TeacherDialogJob{}, ErrInvalidTeacherDialogJob
		}
	}
	for _, value := range []string{input.TeacherJobID, input.DecisionID, input.DeliveredMessageID, input.AIExecutionID, input.StudentCommandID, input.NoEffectProofID, input.RecoverableOutcomeID} {
		if value != "" && !validUUID(value) {
			return TeacherDialogJob{}, ErrInvalidTeacherDialogJob
		}
	}
	if input.ReconciliationState != "" && input.ReconciliationState != TeacherTurnUnknown && input.ReconciliationState != TeacherTurnPartial && input.ReconciliationState != TeacherTurnCommittedUnreconciled {
		return TeacherDialogJob{}, ErrInvalidTeacherDialogJob
	}
	if input.TerminalOutcome != "" && input.TerminalOutcome != TeacherTurnDelivered && input.TerminalOutcome != TeacherTurnFailedNoEffect {
		return TeacherDialogJob{}, ErrInvalidTeacherDialogJob
	}
	if input.Request.UsesDenseTeacherOrdering() && input.Request.TeacherTurnSequence < 1 {
		return TeacherDialogJob{}, ErrInvalidTeacherDialogJob
	}

	activeLease := validUUID(input.ClaimToken) && input.WorkerID != "" && !input.LockedUntil.IsZero()
	inactiveLease := input.ClaimToken == "" && input.WorkerID == "" && input.LockedUntil.IsZero()
	generatedLegacy := input.CoordinatorMode == "legacy" && input.DecisionID != "" && input.ResponseBody != ""
	generatedCoordinator := input.CoordinatorMode != "legacy" && input.DecisionID == "" && input.ResponseBody != ""
	generated := generatedLegacy || generatedCoordinator
	ungenerated := input.DecisionID == "" && input.ResponseBody == ""
	retainedPendingPractice := generatedLegacy && input.Attempts > 0 &&
		(input.Request.ContextType == LearningContextPracticeTask || input.Request.ContextType == LearningContextProject) &&
		input.DeliveredMessageID == "" && input.DeliveredAt.IsZero()

	switch input.Status {
	case TeacherDialogJobQueued:
		if !inactiveLease || !ungenerated || input.DeliveredMessageID != "" || !input.DeliveredAt.IsZero() || input.TerminalOutcome != "" || input.ReconciliationState != "" || input.NoEffectProofID != "" || input.RecoverableOutcomeID != "" {
			return TeacherDialogJob{}, ErrInvalidTeacherDialogJob
		}
	case TeacherDialogJobProcessing:
		if !activeLease || input.Attempts < 1 || (!generated && !ungenerated) ||
			input.DeliveredMessageID != "" || !input.DeliveredAt.IsZero() || input.TerminalOutcome != "" || input.ReconciliationState != "" || input.NoEffectProofID != "" || input.RecoverableOutcomeID != "" {
			return TeacherDialogJob{}, ErrInvalidTeacherDialogJob
		}
	case TeacherDialogJobDeliveryPending:
		if !inactiveLease || input.Attempts < 1 || !generated || input.DeliveredMessageID != "" || !input.DeliveredAt.IsZero() || input.TerminalOutcome != "" || input.ReconciliationState != "" || input.NoEffectProofID != "" || input.RecoverableOutcomeID != "" {
			return TeacherDialogJob{}, ErrInvalidTeacherDialogJob
		}
	case TeacherDialogJobDelivered:
		if !inactiveLease || input.Attempts < 1 || (input.CoordinatorMode == "legacy" && input.DecisionID == "") || (input.CoordinatorMode != "legacy" && input.DecisionID != "") || input.ResponseBody != "" ||
			input.DeliveredMessageID == "" || input.DeliveredAt.IsZero() || input.ErrorCode != "" || input.ReconciliationState != "" || input.NoEffectProofID != "" || input.RecoverableOutcomeID != "" || input.TerminalOutcome == TeacherTurnFailedNoEffect {
			return TeacherDialogJob{}, ErrInvalidTeacherDialogJob
		}
		if input.TerminalOutcome != "" && input.TerminalOutcome != TeacherTurnDelivered {
			return TeacherDialogJob{}, ErrInvalidTeacherDialogJob
		}
	case TeacherDialogJobCompleted:
		if !inactiveLease || input.Attempts < 1 || input.DecisionID != "" || input.ResponseBody != "" || input.DeliveredMessageID != "" || !input.DeliveredAt.IsZero() || input.ErrorCode == "" || input.TerminalOutcome != TeacherTurnFailedNoEffect || input.ReconciliationState != "" || !validUUID(input.NoEffectProofID) || !validUUID(input.RecoverableOutcomeID) {
			return TeacherDialogJob{}, ErrInvalidTeacherDialogJob
		}
	case TeacherDialogJobBlocked:
		if !inactiveLease || (input.ResponseBody != "" && !retainedPendingPractice) ||
			(input.DeliveredMessageID != "" && input.ReconciliationState != TeacherTurnCommittedUnreconciled) ||
			!input.DeliveredAt.IsZero() || input.ErrorCode == "" || input.TerminalOutcome != "" || input.NoEffectProofID != "" || input.RecoverableOutcomeID != "" {
			return TeacherDialogJob{}, ErrInvalidTeacherDialogJob
		}
	default:
		return TeacherDialogJob{}, ErrInvalidTeacherDialogJob
	}
	return input, nil
}

func NormalizeTeacherResponseBody(body string) (string, error) {
	body = strings.TrimSpace(body)
	if body == "" || !utf8.ValidString(body) || len(body) > maximumTeacherResponseBytes || utf8.RuneCountInString(body) > maximumTeacherResponseRunes {
		return "", ErrInvalidTeacherDialogJob
	}
	return body, nil
}

func NormalizeTeacherDialogErrorCode(code string) (string, error) {
	code = strings.TrimSpace(code)
	if code == "" || len(code) > 64 {
		return "", ErrInvalidTeacherDialogJob
	}
	return code, nil
}

// TeacherCoordinatedDialogResponse is staged before Dialog append and is the
// only S5 exception to the legacy TeacherDecision requirement. Assistant UI
// is validated/digested here; it never comes directly from a model response.
type TeacherCoordinatedDialogResponse struct {
	Mode        string
	Body        string
	AssistantUI json.RawMessage
}

func NewTeacherCoordinatedDialogResponse(input TeacherCoordinatedDialogResponse) (TeacherCoordinatedDialogResponse, error) {
	input.Mode = strings.TrimSpace(input.Mode)
	body, err := NormalizeTeacherResponseBody(input.Body)
	if err != nil || (input.Mode != "onboarding_action" && input.Mode != "onboarding_text") {
		return TeacherCoordinatedDialogResponse{}, ErrInvalidTeacherDialogJob
	}
	input.Body = body
	if len(input.AssistantUI) != 0 {
		if _, err := DigestTeacherAssistantUI(input.AssistantUI); err != nil {
			return TeacherCoordinatedDialogResponse{}, ErrInvalidTeacherDialogJob
		}
		input.AssistantUI = append(json.RawMessage(nil), input.AssistantUI...)
	}
	return input, nil
}
